slot_note: seed DQ01 (which guardrail metric the experiment platform's automated alert watches); architecture 2, re-rooted in the same objective after architecture 1 was spent: the object is a soil moisture reference network's data health and the call is which stations the spring crew re-installs before the drought monitor anchors on them
niche: a prairie soil moisture reference network choosing which eight of its 56 stations the spring field crew re-installs before the drought monitor starts anchoring its satellite soil moisture layer on them, ranked on each station's own random error against the true soil moisture of its satellite cell
answer: Re-install Spiritwood N, Swift Current E, Kindersley W, Davidson W, Pense, Watrous S, Melfort N and Kandahar in the April 2027 window, largest tracking error first.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the logger, satellite and model files and reads every field and rule correctly runs the field's standard triple collocation of station, morning retrieval and land-surface model and re-installs Balgonie S, Grand Coulee and Regina W in place of Watrous S, Melfort N and Kandahar, because over the clay plains the two products take texture from the same soil map and their errors co-vary, which no rule states and only an independent fourth series, a second station in the cell, separates.
domain_test: Separating a soil moisture station's own random error from a satellite retrieval's and a land-surface model's by collocation, and recognising from their ancillary inputs that two of the three share a soil texture map and so cannot serve as independent references where that map is wrong, is the core of in-situ reference validation in environmental remote sensing; with another field's nouns there are no independent observing systems of one geophysical field whose error structure follows from the ancillary data each one ingests.
layer1: hourly logger tables in UTC, one parquet file per calendar year, two probe depths, a firmware column added in the latest file, against a delivery day kept in Saskatchewan's year-round UTC-6
re-sent duplicate hours with later receive times after logger restarts
-9999 failed reads, lost hours and frozen-soil hours
probe and logger replacements in the register's probe and logger sheets, and a visit log with dd/mm/yyyy dates before 2022 and ISO after

satellite retrievals dated by local solar date with observation seconds since J2000, two passes a day, bit-packed quality and surface flags, -9999 fill, and a superseded version 4 extract beside version 5
land-surface model layer water in millimetres over 0 to 10 cm on a 0.1 degree grid, six-hourly UTC
station coordinates to be placed on the 36 km EASE grid by cell bounds and on the model's 0.1 degree boxes
station tipping-bucket gauges, daily for the Saskatchewan day, run 1 April to 31 October with the buckets closed over winter

world.org_type: provincial agroclimate research centre running a soil moisture reference network

driver: Each unit's own random error against a signal nothing observes decides the ranking, and the two comparators that could separate it share an input in one region, so their errors co-vary there and the standard three-way covariance separation charges that region's units with the comparators' shared error; a fourth series independent of both, a second unit observing the same signal, separates each unit's error where the shared input bites, and the three-way answer misses the right set by three swaps.
driver_concrete: The spring crew can re-install eight of the network's 56 stations, ranked on each station's own random error against its satellite cell's true soil moisture (NS-03 s.2.1); the Ninox retrieval and the PLSM model both take soil texture from the same 1:1 million provincial soil map, which carries the heavy clay plains as clay loam, so over the two clay cells their errors co-vary and triple collocation of station, retrieval and model charges Balgonie S, Grand Coulee and Regina W with the products' shared error; collocating with the morning retrieval and a second station in the same cell (the model only in the three single-station cells, none on the clay) returns Spiritwood N, Swift Current E, Kindersley W, Davidson W, Pense, Watrous S, Melfort N and Kandahar.
stump: A competent solver who reads NS-03 s.2.1 as asking for each station's own error separates it by triple collocation of the station, the morning retrieval and the PLSM model and re-installs Balgonie S, Grand Coulee and Regina W in place of Watrous S, Melfort N and Kandahar; the step that lands it there is treating the retrieval and the model as independent references over the heavy clay plains, where both take their texture from the same provincial soil map and err together, which a second station in the cell separates.

differentiation.task107: task107 v2 scaled a lottery pilot's assignment effect by receipt that the comparison arm also got through reassigned practitioners, a contamination reached through a staff directory; this build separates each station's own measurement error from two products whose errors co-vary over the clay plains, because both take soil texture from the same provincial soil map, so plain triple collocation of station, retrieval and model charges their shared error to the stations there and a second station in the cell, a fourth series independent of both, separates it; no treatment, no assignment and no contamination, and the shared input is a filed ancillary dataset, not a channel that carries a treatment
differentiation.task228: architecture 1 calibrated a paging threshold on the record's runs that look like the season's; architecture 2 as cut for round 3 separated each station's error by plain triple collocation; this cut turns on the two products sharing one ancillary input, so their errors are not independent over the clay plains and a fourth independent series (a second station in the cell) is needed there, a different decisive step from plain collocation
differentiation.task134: task134 chooses cumulative incidence over Kaplan-Meier for a recidivism return probability under competing exits (a competing exit is not a censored observation); this build estimates each soil moisture station's own random error where its two standard comparators, the retrieval and the model, take soil texture from the same provincial soil map, so over the clay plains their errors co-vary, plain triple collocation charges the shared error to the stations, and a second station in the cell, independent of both, separates it. Both are estimator choices pinned by a stated estimand, and since loop 1 both turn on an independence-type assumption of the standard estimator failing in one segment; the claims differ (who stays in the risk set, against whether two comparators are independent), as do the domains, the data structures and the drivers.

lineage.fate: hardened 2026-10-11: round 3 landed the call on the solver's step 6, plain triple collocation of station, morning retrieval and model; that step is now a lower rung that completes and returns the wrong eight, because the two products share the soil map's texture over the clay plains
lineage.driver: Each unit's own random error against a signal that nothing observes decides the ranking, and every comparison available carries the comparator's own error, which here is largest exactly where units sit in a comparator's weak conditions; three independent measurements of one signal identify each one's error from their pairwise covariances, so ranking units on their disagreement with one comparator, with whichever comparator they match better, or with the comparators' average sends the scarce visits to sound units in the comparators' weak spots.
lineage.driver_concrete: The spring crew can re-install eight of the network's 56 stations, and the network standard ranks stations on their own random error against the true soil moisture of their satellite cell; the retrieval errs most over the parkland and pothole cells and the land-surface model (no irrigation, no ponding) over the irrigation district, the clay plain and the potholes, so a station's unbiased error against either product, the better of the two or their mean carries that product's error, and only triple collocation of station, retrieval and model on their common mornings separates the station's own error.
lineage.stump: A competent solver places each station in its Ninox cell, matches its 5 cm reading at the morning overpass to the recommended-quality morning retrieval, treats the retrieval as the cell's soil moisture, ranks the 56 stations by their unbiased error against it and sends the crew to Kandahar plus seven sound pothole-country stations (Avonlea W, Briercrest, Dafoe, Dirt Hills, Muenster, Wynyard E, Yorkton W); the step that lands it there is charging each station with the retrieval's own error, and the model, the better reference or the two references' mean keep a reference's error too (2, 2 and 4 of the eight), when triple collocation of station, retrieval and model on the tracking mornings separates each station's own error and puts five open-cropland stations among the eight.
lineage.answer: Re-install Swift Current E, Kindersley W, Davidson W, Watrous S, Melfort N, Pense, Kandahar and Spiritwood N in April 2027, in that order (own errors 0.048 to 0.034 m3/m3; ninth Craik E 0.024)
